title: Twin Magnolia RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Twin Magnolia RV Park in North Augusta is the place to camp and stop for a relaxing getaway. Our campground has it all, Full Rv hookups for monthly Rv camping 30 & 50 amp electric service (you pay electric), internet available at each site. We have excellent rates and we pride ourselves on our friendly service. We strive to maintain a clean and well kept campground.
